name: SproutOS – Create Creative Sites with AI
author: POSIMYTH

sections.description:
SproutOS creates WordPress sites with AI, the agency way, ready to launch. You design your site in Create Mode at https://sproutos.ai, and this plugin imports it into WordPress.

Create Mode turns a client brief into a real, on-brand website, not AI slop. You stay in control at every step, and nothing is locked: every section is handmade and yours to edit.

How Create Mode Works

Create Mode follows one simple flow: Scope, Sitemap, Design, Export.

  • Scope: start from real client context (a brief, a document, or a call transcript). The AI pre-fills, and you override anything.
  • Sitemap: plan the pages and sections, like brainstorming with a client.
  • Design: set your own colors, typography, and sections, on brand.
  • Export: approve on the canvas and export production-ready WordPress.

From SproutOS To WordPress

When your design is ready, this plugin brings it into WordPress:

  • Import to Elementor or Gutenberg
  • Global styles (buttons, colors, typography) stay global after import
  • Sections come in fully editable, so you can keep working in WordPress

You create at https://sproutos.ai and import here. That is the whole job of this plugin.

Why Teams Use It

  • AI speed without AI slop: flow, not slop
  • The agency way: handmade sections, nothing locked
  • Ready to launch: real pages you can ship, not throwaway mockups

Set Up In Three Steps

  1. Install and activate SproutOS.
  2. Sign in to your SproutOS account at https://sproutos.ai and design your site in Create Mode.
  3. Import the site into WordPress from the SproutOS admin, and keep editing in Elementor or Gutenberg.

Who It Is For

WordPress agencies, freelancers, and site builders who want to go from a client brief to a real, on-brand WordPress site fast, without hand-building every page from scratch.

External Services

This plugin connects to the SproutOS service at https://sproutos.ai to sign you in and import the websites you create in Create Mode. Your site details and the content you choose to import are sent there to perform the requested work. Terms: https://sproutos.ai/privacy-policy?tab=terms . Privacy: https://sproutos.ai/privacy-policy?tab=privacy .

Development

SproutOS is open source (GPLv2 or later) and nothing in it is obfuscated. The complete, human-readable source for the compiled dashboard is maintained publicly at https://github.com/posimyth/sproutos/tree/sproutos-source

For the full compiled-file-to-source map and build steps, see the Source-Readme.txt file in the plugin root.
sections.installation:
1. Install SproutOS from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/sproutos.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Sign in at https://sproutos.ai, design your site in Create Mode, and import it into WordPress from the SproutOS admin.

Requirements: WordPress 6.9+ and PHP 8.0+.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It imports the websites you design in SproutOS Create Mode into WordPress. You create the site at https://sproutos.ai, then use this plugin to bring it in as Elementor or Gutenberg pages you can edit.

What is Create Mode?

Create Mode is the AI site-creation side of SproutOS. It takes a client brief and walks it through Scope, Sitemap, Design, and Export to produce a real, on-brand WordPress site, ready to launch.

Do I build the site in WordPress or at sproutos.ai?

You design it at https://sproutos.ai in Create Mode, where the AI helps you go from brief to finished design. This plugin is the WordPress side: it imports the finished site into your WordPress install.

Which builders can I import to?

Elementor and Gutenberg. Global styles stay global after import, and sections come in editable so you can keep refining them in WordPress.

Do I need a SproutOS account?

Yes. Create an account at https://sproutos.ai to use Create Mode. This plugin connects your WordPress site to that account so you can import.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. You work in plain English in Create Mode, and edit the imported pages visually in Elementor or Gutenberg.

Will it work with my theme?

Imported pages are built with Elementor or Gutenberg, so they work with most standard WordPress themes.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

The import connection is removed. Any pages you already imported stay in WordPress, untouched.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The plugin runs only when you import a site. There is no load on your visitors.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Improvement : SproutOS now focuses on Create Mode. Design your WordPress site with AI at sproutos.ai and import it into WordPress as Elementor or Gutenberg pages.
  • Improvement : Simplified and cleaned up the plugin for a lighter, faster setup.
  • Fix : Minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

1.2.0

  • New : API-based MCP architecture.
  • Update : Major platform revamp from the abilities-based engine to an API-based MCP setup.
  • Removed : Memory functionality.
  • Removed : Sandbox environment.
  • Removed : Integrations for Elementor, Bricks, ACF, Pods, Divi, Breakdance, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, ASE, and other page builder features.
  • Improvement : Simplified and cleaned up the core architecture.
  • Fix : Minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

1.1.5

  • Fix : Minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

1.1.3

  • Fix : Minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

1.1.1

  • Improvement : UI improvements across the dashboard.
  • New : Dark mode option for the dashboard.
  • Fix : Minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

1.1.0

  • New : Create Mode Included
  • Improvement : Code cleanup and optimizations and removed unused code

0.0.11

  • Improvement : Code cleanup and optimizations – removed unused server-rendered code and dead assets.

0.0.10

  • Improvement : Rebuilt the admin dashboard as a React app (same design, no feature changes).
  • New : Setting to show or hide the “AI ACTIVE” indicator in the WordPress admin bar.

0.0.9

  • Improvement : Dashboard design and layout improvement.

0.0.8

  • Update : Removed theme file read and list abilities.
  • Improvement : Reduced the filesystem surface further.
